### I Am the Way
Author: Emma Danzey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/i-am-the-way-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: John 14:5-6
Points:
- Jesus welcomes sincere questions and uncertainties rather than rejecting believers when they do not understand.
- Christ provides a direct, unambiguous answer to Thomas by declaring Himself to be the path to eternal life.
- Against worldly ideas that all spiritual roads are equivalent, Jesus is the exclusive mediator to the Father.
- Believers can live with enduring assurance and peace, knowing their redemption is secured through Christ.

### The Way, the Truth, the Life
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/way-truth-life
Passage: John 14:6
Points:
- Facing His impending departure, Jesus anchored His troubled disciples with substantive theological truth.
- Christ is the only entrance into God's kingdom and the secure guarantor of eternal life.
- Because Jesus is the ultimate standard of divine truth, trusting Him is grounded in reality rather than wishful thinking.
- Professing Christ as the Truth calls believers to accept the full reliability and authority of the Scriptures.
